title: Divide and Conquer/Quotes
summary:
"Impressive. That's not a spell you see everyday."
- Dante Vale to Zhalia Moon, about using Headcage

"I'm gonna give you a chance to back out, since you don't know what you're in for."
- Dante Vale to Suits

"Are you trying to get yourself killed?" (Sophie Casterwill)

"Yeah, uh, I mean no." (Lok Lambert)

"Grier, I get the feeling there's more to you. Something that you're hiding from me?" (Dante Vale)
"Says the man who is hiding something from everybody." (Grier)
